definitions.gloss: resourcefulness; quick wit; talent for practical problem-solving
definitions.explanation: The ability to think quickly and find clever solutions, especially in practical or business matters. Implies a combination of intelligence and pragmatic adaptability.

definitions.gloss: means of raising money; financial resourcefulness
definitions.explanation: The ability to procure money or resources when needed, often through clever or industrious means.

notes:
Combines {才|さい} (talent) with {覚|かく} (perception/awareness). Emphasizes practical, street-smart intelligence rather than academic brilliance. Historically associated with merchant culture in the Edo period.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {才覚|さいかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be resourceful
- {才覚|さいかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a resourceful person
- ⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{才覚|さいかく}: business acumen
- ⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{才覚|さいかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to find a way to raise money
- ⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{才覚|さいかく}: means of procuring funds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧: talent; ability — more general, can refer to any kind of talent including artistic or academic. {才覚|さいかく} specifically implies practical cleverness.
- ⟦{機転|きてん}→機転：10603_kiten⟧: quick thinking; tact — focuses on responding well in the moment, while {才覚|さいかく} implies a broader, enduring quality.
- ⟦{知恵|ちえ}→知恵：03428_chie⟧: wisdom; resourcefulness — warmer and more everyday; {才覚|さいかく} has a slightly more formal, literary tone.
